House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Transportation Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for the safe routes to school and active transportation programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SAFE ROUTES TO SCHOOL AND ACTIVE TRANSPORTATION. +]

[+$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $10,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from ....... to the commissioner of transportation for: (1) the safe routes to school program under Minnesota Statutes, section 174.40; and (2) the active transportation program under Minnesota Statutes, section 174.38. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for the safe routes to school and active transportation programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SAFE ROUTES TO SCHOOL AND ACTIVE TRANSPORTATION.

$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $10,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from ....... to the commissioner of transportation for: (1) the safe routes to school program under Minnesota Statutes, section 174.40; and (2) the active transportation program under Minnesota Statutes, section 174.38.
additions: APPROPRIATION; SAFE ROUTES TO SCHOOL AND ACTIVE TRANSPORTATION.
